verdict.rationale: Telephony bridging is a fair question for a real-time voice platform, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is a marketing line that the conversational AI offering supports phone calls. Nothing documents SIP trunking or interoperability with a customer's own carrier or telephony provider, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the service documents SIP interoperability with my existing trunking or telephony provider rather than locking me to one carrier
